jobs.title: Senior Director Marketing PCHP
jobs.description:
Location: Mockingbird Towers 4th FLR

Primary Purpose

Responsible for providing strategic leadership for the development and execution of PCHP's marketing, communications, and public relations strategy to promote member, provider, staff, and community engagement.

MINIMUM SPECIFICATIONS

Education

Bachelor's degree in business administration, communications, journalism, marketing, public relations or related discipline required.
Master's degree in business administration, healthcare administration, marketing or related discipline preferred.

Experience

Seven (7) years of experience in healthcare sales, marketing, and member experience required.
Five (5) years of leadership experience.
New product development, positioning, and start-up experience required.
Marketing segmentation experience required.
Experience with Texas Medicaid or Medicaid Managed Care preferred.
Bilingual speaking ability preferred.

Equivalent Education And/or Experience

Eight (8) years of experience in a comparable position working in Texas Medicaid or Medicaid Managed Care may be considered in lieu of a bachelor's degree.

Skills Or Special Abilities

Excellent verbal and written communication skills including the ability to communicate effectively and professionally across disciplines and with a variety of constituents as well as the ability to articulate complex information in understandable terms.
Exceptional networking and negotiation skills.
Strong public speaking and presentation skills.
Demonstrated ability to coach and influence for results.
Strong interpersonal and conflict resolution skills with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with diverse groups across and beyond the organization.
Strategic thinking and long-range planning skills with the ability to lead major organizational initiatives, accomplish results, and achieve measurable outcomes or goals.
Ability to work in challenging situations involving competing interests, and high level-interdisciplinary groups.
Excellent time management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple demands and respond to rapidly changing priorities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of Texas Medicaid (STAR, STAR Kids/CHIP) program, National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), the Uniformed Managed Care Contract, and the Uniform Managed Care Manual.
Sound business acumen.
Proficient Microsoft Office and computer skills.

Responsibilities

Strategy

Employs data-driven strategies and tactics to achieve organizational goals and objectives related to membership growth & retention, community engagement, as well as member, provider, and employee engagement across current and future lines of business.
Works collaboratively across the organization (e.g., Strategy, Member Services, Provider Relations, Quality, Healthcare Services and others) to facilitate effective communication with constituents, achieve organizational goals, and ensure compliance with contractual and regulatory marketing guidelines.
Develops and implements the strategic marketing and communications plan to meet PCHP's business goals to include earned media, social media, web, e-news, email, video, internal communication, collateral, events and sponsorships.
Analyzes data and trends to measure growth, engagement, ROI, and effectiveness of strategies, tactics, and initiatives. Uses data and analyses to develop plans/budgets and inform strategic decisions.
Engages in data-driven decision making; adjusts plans, initiatives, and activities based on data insights to accomplish goals.

Operations

Develops, implements, and measures initiatives to achieve goals related to membership growth. Monitors monthly metrics, disseminates information, and adjusts activities as needed to reach established targets. Metrics may include member choice, HHSC assignment, default assignment, retention, disenrollment, etc.
Oversees PCHP's marketing and communications team to create and implement brand, integrated marketing, digital, advertising, and PR strategies and plans. Manages staff responsible for websites, portals, member app, social media, SMS, email, print, graphic design, and copy writing.
Develops, publishes and updates branding and communications plans in conjunction with PCHP leadership to support strategic goals and objectives of the organization.
Oversees internal communication channels including newsletters, town hall meetings, etc. and supports employee engagement initiatives as requested.
Facilitates external communication through creation of annual reports, member and provider materials, board presentations, etc. ensuring consistency with the PCHP brand and messaging and compliance with regulatory requirements.
Supports Provider Relations team in developing and disseminating information to PCHP's provider network through various channels.
Supports Quality, Healthcare Services, Population Health, Disease Management, Member Relations, and others in developing and disseminating information PCHP's members through various channels.
Collaborates as needed with system Corporate Communications and Marketing teams.
Designs, implements, and oversees PCHP's community engagement program.
Develops and oversees the execution of PCHP's community engagement strategy, ensuring health equity, education and the social determinants of health are integrated across the enterprise and into community at points of service.
Builds strategic relationships (both formal and informal) with community-, faith-, and school-based organizations, civic organizations, advocacy groups and others that serve similar communities throughout PCHP's service area.
Oversees the staff responsible for community engagement activities; directs and participates in the development and implementation of goals, objectives, and priorities to ensure project and program objectives are met.
May represent PCHP throughout the service area as a community influencer.
Designs, implements, and oversees PCHP's value-added services.
Collaborates with colleagues to design and measure the impact of value-added services which influence member choice, healthy behaviors, and completion of HEDIS-related healthcare encounters.
Solicits input from members, providers, and staff to incorporate the voice of the customer.
Advises and guides senior executives as needed related to crisis communication.
Encourages creativity, innovation, and collaboration among staff and colleagues.
Creates messaging and materials that reflect Parkland's values of equity and inclusion.

Quality

Integrate health literacy principles into all communication including Members and Providers.
Support strategies that meet clinical, quality and network improvement goals.
Promote the use of Health Information Technology to support and monitor the effectiveness of health and social interventions and make data-driven recommendations as needed.
For staff in clinical roles, foster collaborative relationships with members and/or providers to promote and support evidence-based practices and care coordination.

Regulatory

Develop processes to maintain compliance with regulatory agencies and accrediting bodies. Ensures operations are carried out in compliance with these regulations.
Works collaboratively with others to validate and sustain compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards.
Conducts routine compliance audits identifying gaps and implementing remediation plans as necessary.
Works collaboratively with leadership and/or PCHP Compliance to investigate and respond to matters of concern or alleged violations taking corrective action as necessary.
Provides timely and accurate responses to requests for information from regulatory agencies and accrediting bodies.
Develops Marketing training materials for member-facing staff to ensure understanding of HHSC, TDI, and other regulatory requirements.
Establishes comprehensive policies and procedures to standardize operations and ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation requirements.
Ensures timely development and submission of marketing deliverables as required by regulatory and accrediting bodies.

Fiscal Management and Operating Budget

Operationally responsible for the financial performance of assigned area(s).
Promote activities to achieve operational efficiency.
Manage the approved budget through frequent and regular monitoring. Implement written action plans to address variances adjusting strategies as necessary to meet budgetary targets.
Consider operational outcomes and financial implications when making recommendations to implement new programs or modify current programs.
Establishes and manages vendor relationships related to community engagement, marketing, and value-added services.
Manage staffing levels within established targets.

Talent Management

Recruit and retain diverse talent with a variety of backgrounds, skills, experiences, and viewpoints that reflect the communities we serve.
Promote and support a culturally welcoming, inclusive, collaborative, and highly engaged work environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.
Accountable for orientation, ongoing education and training, and competency verification for all employees.
Ensure Human Resource metrics (i.e., retention, vacancy, engagement) meet established targets. Utilize workforce metrics to monitor, identify, and respond to workforce trends.
Timely completion of employee performance appraisals.
Conduct regular meetings, inform team of changes in policy or procedure, and provide information regarding overall strategy and direction of the health plan.
Mentor, coach, and support direct reports with building teamwork, professional development, and education to achieve optimal performance and develop talent.
Ensure employee engagement survey participation rates and results meet established targets.
Mandatory requirements are completed timely by employees. Required licensure, certification, and/or registry are current and in good standing for all employees.
Employee performance is monitored and managed. Consult with the Office of Talent Management as appropriate regarding employee performance concerns and disciplinary action.

Professional Accountability

Acts with the highest integrity and ethical standards while adhering to Parkland's Mission, Vision, and Values.
Adheres to organizational policies, procedures, and guidelines. Completes assigned training, self-appraisal, and annual health requirements timely.
Adheres to hybrid work schedule requirements.
Attends required meetings and town halls.
Recognizes and communicate ethical and legal concerns through the established channels of communication.
Demonstrates accountability and responsibility by independently completing work, including projects and assignments on time, and providing timely responses to requests for information.
Maintains confidentiality at all times.
Performs other work as requested that is reasonably related to the employee's position, qualifications, and competencies.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Consultant - Paid Media - Business Banking
jobs.description:
About This Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a highly motivated Paid Media Lead to oversee paid media strategy and performance for key Business Banking initiatives. The successful candidate will combine analytical rigor, strategic thinking, and media expertise to optimize investments, unlock growth opportunities, and deliver measurable business impact. This role is ideal for a marketing professional who thrives in a fast-paced, complex environment and is passionate about using media as a driver of business results.

In This Role, You Will

Lead the development and execution of paid media strategies across Video, Audio, Social, Search, and other digital channels in support of Business Banking objectives.
Own day-to-day campaign planning, activation, optimization, and budget pacing to ensure delivery against KPIs, timelines, and investment goals.
Partner with media agencies and platform partners to oversee buying, optimization, measurement, and performance reporting.
Translate business objectives and media briefs into channel strategies, tactical plans, and investment recommendations.
Monitor campaign performance and leverage data-driven insights to optimize media effectiveness and business outcomes.
Collaborate with analytics, creative, brand, risk, and compliance partners to deliver compliant, on-brand, and performance-driven campaigns.
Lead test-and-learn initiatives across channels, audiences, and media partners, documenting insights and recommendations to inform future investment strategies.
Lead complex, cross-functional marketing initiatives and contribute to annual planning, prioritization, and strategic decision-making.
Evaluate business, operational, and marketing challenges, developing recommendations that balance performance objectives, risk considerations, and execution requirements.
Build strong partnerships across lines of business, marketing, analytics, technology, compliance, and vendor teams while providing leadership, guidance, and mentorship to peers and project teams.
Serve as a trusted paid media advisor, providing strategic guidance and recommendations to business and marketing partners.
Influence decisions through data-driven insights, sound judgment, and a strong understanding of business objectives.
Navigate a complex, matrixed organization while building alignment across diverse stakeholders and functions.
Champion a test-and-learn culture, using measurement and experimentation to improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and leadership by proactively identifying opportunities, mitigating risks, and driving results.

Required Qualifications

4+ years of Marketing, Digital Marketing, Digital Platforms (i.e. Mobile or Social Media) experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications

Proven experience managing paid media programs for well-established national brands, either within an in-house marketing organization or at a leading media agency
Experience leveraging marketing measurement frameworks, experimentation methodologies, and business performance data to evaluate marketing effectiveness and inform investment decisions.
Experience with success working within large, matrixed organizations that require partnership across multiple stakeholders, business units, and governance functions
Strong understanding of the marketing ecosystem, including media, analytics, creative, technology, and customer experience disciplines.
Exceptional communication, influence, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to build credibility across all levels of an organization

Job Expectations

Ability to travel 10% of the time
Hybrid work schedule. Must be able to work from one of the approved jobs posting locations three (3) days in office & two (2) days remote
This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship.
Relocation assistance is not available for this position

Pay Range

Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities.

$87,000.00 - $140,000.00

Discounts and savings

26 Oct 2026

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

What You'll Do

As Hadrian's first product marketer you will drive how the market understands what we build and the impact it has. You'll work closely with Brand, Federal, Sales, Recruiting, and Hadrian leadership. This is a new function that you will have the opportunity to help shape from the ground up.

Set the positioning for every Hadrian offering: what we call it, who it’s for, and why it beats the alternatives. Embed with our engineers and customers until you can make the technical case to a customer’s engineering team as well as their executives.
Translate technical differentiation into mission impact. Make the copy, media, and products that show what our offerings do and why they matter. Find the proof in schedule, quality, and throughput, keeping positioning connected to customer results.
Equip every team that carries Hadrian's story with the narratives, competitive positioning, and product demos they need. Bring back what lands and use it to sharpen the story and inform the product.
Build the product marketing team: hire the specialists who join you, and develop a bench of design, video, and writing contractors you can call on.

What We're Looking For

5+ years at companies with technically complex products, with demonstrated experience defining their positioning and go-to-market. You learn complex systems quickly and turn them into clear, credible narratives. Engineers trust your technical explanations, whether they work here or at a customer. Your path may run through product marketing, technical marketing, engineering, or technical design.
AI-native, and relentless about it. We're looking for a ridiculously high-pace, high-agency marketer who uses AI to compress everything: research, writing, design, and production. You can show us concretely how AI already makes you multiples faster, and you're hungry to push it further.
Full stack across the craft. You write sharp copy and design strong slides, diagrams, and product graphics yourself, reaching for whatever medium best conveys the message. You have the taste to direct designers and video editors when the work calls for a specialist.
High-agency builder. You've been first or early in a function, found what was missing, and built it without waiting for a brief. You have a portfolio of work you personally made and can tell us which parts were yours.
Driven by the mission and the tempo. Rebuilding the industrial base matters to you, and you care about shipping at the pace our customers and teams need.

What Will Set You Apart

Experience in manufacturing, aerospace, defense, robotics, or industrial hardware, including selling to government customers or large primes.
A background in engineering, industrial design, or technical design.
A track record of content and positioning you can tie to business outcomes, such as pipeline, closed deals, or hires.
Video editing, motion design, or 3D skills.
Experience hiring contractors and growing a team around your work.

Benefits for Full-time Employees

Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 401k
Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
Flexible vacation policy
Equity

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Use of AI in hiring

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

Consideration of Criminal History

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

Hadrian Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Job Overview

The Sr Commercial Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and implementing strategies which promote company growth and awareness across the prepaid consumer base with a focus on increasing revenue per account (ARPA). This role develops strategies and campaigns for prepaid services and products, factoring in market dynamics, consumer patterns, competitive actions, retailer/channel conflict, etc. The Sr Commercial Marketing Manager will partner with multiple internal and external groups such as Market Intelligence, Product, Data/Analytics, Offers, Retail, Marketing and Operations to define and implement strategic vision. They will lead the discovery phase for new opportunities and present recommendations and results to senior leadership. This is a great opportunity for an analytical, creative and innovative professional to identify new solutions and carry out projects in a large, supported environment.

Collaborate closely with product, business, deployment and GTM teams to plan and implement campaigns across multiple channels including outbound, digital and retail placements.

jobs.description:
Job Snapshot

Location: Irvine, CA | Onsite
Pay: $100,000 - $120,000/year
Employment Type: Permanent Placement
Work Type: Full-time
Experience Level: Mid Level

Opportunity Summary

A purpose-led, rapidly growing wellness food and beverage company is looking for a Trade Marketing Manager to turn brand strategy into programs that move product off the shelf. You'll be the bridge between Sales and Marketing
, building the promotions, launches, and in-store activations that drive distribution and velocity across national, regional, natural, mass, club, and convenience retailers. It's a high-impact seat
where you'll own the trade strategy and see your results show up in the numbers.

Responsibilities

Build and execute the annual trade marketing strategy, with customer- and channel-specific plans and retailer promotional calendars
Plan and run promotions, displays, sampling, demos, retailer media, and in-store activations
Create 30-, 60-, and 90-day support plans for new retailer and product launches
Manage trade spend against budget, measure promotional ROI, and recommend where to invest next
Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations, brokers, and distributors to make sure retailer commitments are executed at store level

Required

5+ years of trade marketing, shopper marketing, customer marketing, brand marketing, or CPG sales/marketing experience, including developing retailer-specific promotional programs
Strong analytical and budget-management skills, with advanced working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint
Ability to manage multiple retailers, programs, and deadlines at once, and to travel up to 30% for retailer meetings, market visits, and events

Preferred

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field
Food, beverage, grocery, natural, mass, or CPG experience
Experience working with national and regional retailers
Familiarity with UNFI, KeHE, grocery distributors, brokers, and third-party merchandising organizations

Own the trade marketing strategy across multiple product categories
Entrepreneurial, rapidly growing company where your work is visible
Work directly with Sales leadership on where and how to invest
Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and PTO

jobs.title: Staff Product Marketing Manager - Data Security
jobs.description:
About Us

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

How We Work

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values

Bold
in how we dream and innovate

Responsive
to feedback, challenges and opportunities

Accountable
for results and best in class outcomes

Visionary
in future focused problem-solving

Exceptional
in execution and impact

The Role

Proofpoint seeks a strategic and innovative Staff Product Marketing Manager to join the Data Security Product Marketing team, supporting a broad portfolio spanning Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Insider Threat Management (ITM), and data security for AI. In this high-impact role, you will be the subject matter expert and market voice for how organizations protect sensitive data wherever people work, communicate, and collaborate. You will shape the narrative for helping customers prevent data loss, reduce insider risk, support compliance, and enable secure productivity across endpoints, email, SaaS applications, and cloud environments. You’ll work cross-functionally with product management, sales, strategic partners, and marketing to deliver differentiated positioning, impactful Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies, and sales enablement.

Your Day to Day

Develop strategic positioning and messaging for Proofpoint’s data security portfolio, including DLP, DSPM, ITM, and data security for AI, anchored in customer needs around data protection, compliance, and secure productivity.
Own GTM strategy and launch planning for new data security capabilities, partnering with product, sales, channel, and demand teams to drive awareness, pipeline, and adoption.
Create high-impact content across solution briefs, web pages, presentations, webinars, demo scripts, blogs, and customer-facing materials.
Build sales and partner enablement, including playbooks, battlecards, objection handling, discovery questions, competitive guidance, and talk tracks.
Track market, buyer, and competitive trends across DLP, insider risk, cloud data security, and adjacent data protection categories.
Serve as a data security subject matter expert in sales trainings, customer briefings, field events, analyst conversations, webinars, and executive presentations.
Partner with product and field teams to translate customer insights, use cases, and adoption patterns into sharper messaging, stronger launches, and more effective GTM.

What you bring to the team

12+ years in product marketing for cybersecurity, data security, DLP, DSPM, insider risk, email security, endpoint security, cloud security, or related enterprise software.
Strong understanding of data security use cases across DLP, DSPM, ITM, endpoint, email, cloud, SaaS applications, AI tools, data classification, policy management, compliance, and incident response.
Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, customer-centric messaging for security, risk, compliance, IT, and executive audiences.
Experience leading GTM strategy, launches, sales enablement, and campaign planning for enterprise security solutions.
Strong market and competitive analysis skills, with the ability to turn insights into positioning, sales guidance, and product feedback.
Excellent communication and presentation skills across executive briefings, analyst conversations, webinars, customer meetings, and industry events.
Collaborative, analytical, and execution-focused, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive measurable business impact.
A bachelor’s degree is required; a technical concentration or MBA is a plus.

Why Proofpoint?

At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us

Competitive compensation
Comprehensive benefits
Career success on your terms
Flexible work environment
Annual wellness and community outreach days
Always on recognition for your contributions
Global collaboration and networking opportunities

Our Culture

Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.

We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.

Shape how one of JPMorganChase Asset & Wealth Management's largest businesses shows up for clients around the world. As Head of Marketing for Global Liquidity, you'll set the global strategy, lead teams across three regions, and help steer the business from a seat on its Operating Committee.

As the Executive Director and Head of Marketing for Global Liquidity, you will set and deliver the global marketing strategy for one of JPMorganChase Asset & Wealth Management's largest businesses. You will lead a regional team across the US, EMEA, and APAC, and serve as a senior marketing leader on the Global Liquidity Operating Committee, partnering with business and functional leadership to drive client acquisition, retention, adoption, and franchise growth.

Own the global marketing strategy for Global Liquidity, aligned to business priorities, client segments, and distribution objectives across regions.
Develop and execute an integrated go-to-market approach across web, email, social, multimedia, and targeted events/field enablement, balancing global consistency with regional relevance.
Partner with Global Liquidity senior leadership as the primary marketing advisor, including the Head of Global Liquidity, Global Sales leadership, Product Strategy, and regional business leads.
Influence and align cross-functional partners across Marketing, Sales, Product, Investments, Technology, and Client Service to deliver integrated outcomes.
Provide concise, executive-ready updates and recommendations to senior forums, including the Global Liquidity Operating Committee.
Lead, coach, and develop a global team of regional marketing leads, setting clear goals, accountability, and a high-performance culture.

Allocate investment across regions and channels based on impact, ensuring transparent prioritization and disciplined financial management.

10 years of progressive marketing experience.

Proven people leadership experience across regions and time zones, with the ability to build an inclusive, high-performing team culture.
Deep capability across digital-first marketing (web, email, social, multimedia), with a strong understanding of channel strategy and audience targeting.
Excellent strategic planning, prioritization, and operating discipline, with the ability to run multiple complex workstreams to high standards.
Strong communication skills (clear, concise writing; confident verbal storytelling; ability to produce executive-ready messaging and materials).
Demonstrated rigor in budget management, business case development, vendor/agency oversight, and ROI-driven decision-making.

Experience supporting multi-region (US, EMEA, APAC) marketing operating models and execution.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Marketing Associate based in United States.

Help shape how innovative products are positioned, launched, and adopted in a fast-moving B2B technology environment. As a Product Marketing Associate, you will develop partner marketing initiatives, craft compelling messaging, and create campaigns that communicate product value to technical buyers and business partners. Working closely with product, marketing, and partner teams, you will translate complex product capabilities into clear, engaging content across multiple channels. You will also gather market insights, refine customer journeys, and measure the impact of your initiatives on adoption, engagement, and activation. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, offering meaningful ownership and opportunities to influence go-to-market activities. Join a remote, collaborative team where initiative, adaptability, and a willingness to build new processes are highly valued.

Accountabilities

You will help develop and execute partner marketing and product marketing initiatives that strengthen product positioning, improve market engagement, and support business growth. Your responsibilities will include:

Build and develop the partner marketing function in collaboration with the Product Marketing Lead, creating messaging assets, campaign materials, and post-launch performance reports.
Work closely with product and marketing teams to define product positioning, value propositions, and messaging for partner features, ensuring consistency across market communications.
Collaborate with marketing and partner teams to design and deliver effective campaigns that engage and activate the partner ecosystem.
Gather and analyze market research, customer feedback, and competitive insights to refine customer personas and targeted marketing journeys.
Track and report on campaign and initiative performance, including adoption, engagement, and activation, according to agreed reporting schedules.
Write campaign assets, creative briefs, and sales or partner enablement materials tailored to different audiences, channels, and formats.
Translate technical product details into clear, compelling messaging that resonates with technical buyers and partners.
Contribute to go-to-market planning and execution, balancing strategic development with hands-on content creation and campaign delivery.
Work cross-functionally with senior stakeholders and teams across product, marketing, and partnerships to align priorities and drive measurable outcomes.
Help establish and improve partner marketing processes, documentation, and workflows as the function evolves.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator with experience in B2B SaaS or product marketing, capable of combining strategic thinking, compelling storytelling, and practical execution. The following qualifications are expected:

2–3 years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing or product marketing.
Demonstrated experience owning go-to-market launches from planning through execution.
Ability to understand technical product capabilities and translate them into relevant messaging for technical buyers and partners.
Excellent writing, storytelling, and communication skills, with experience developing engaging content across multiple channels and formats.
Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with product, marketing, and partner teams.
A proactive, ambitious, and team-oriented mindset, with a willingness to take ownership, drive initiatives independently, and contribute beyond executing predefined briefs.
Comfort working in an evolving environment where processes are still being established and priorities may change.
Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on delivery and adapt messaging to different audiences and business objectives.

Additional Experience That Would Be Advantageous Includes

Experience in payments, financial technology, or marketplaces, with an understanding of the relevant industry landscape.
Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, including developing value propositions for both supply-side and demand-side audiences.

Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.

Job Summary

We're looking for a Principal Marketing Manager
to own the strategic vision for how Vivint builds retention and engagement across every customer touchpoint. This is a role for a marketing leader who sees the whole customer journey — not just campaigns — and who's driven to turn that view into bold, new programs that deepen engagement and keep customers with Vivint for years.

You'll audit the current state of Vivint's marketing experiences across all surfaces, identify where the gaps and opportunities are, and set the strategic direction for what comes next. You'll be the person in the room translating brand insight into customer strategy, and the person leadership turns to when the marketing problem is genuinely hard. This role demands someone who can operate autonomously, bring big ideas to the table, hold their ground when challenged — and challenge others right back.

Own the strategic vision for retention and engagement marketing across the full customer experience — from onboarding through renewal and beyond
Audit existing marketing experiences across all surfaces to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and untapped opportunities
Design and launch new, innovative retention and engagement programs that increase customer stickiness and lifetime value
Translate brand insights into concrete customer strategy, ensuring every experience reinforces why customers chose — and should stay with — Vivint
Partner with and influence senior leadership, shaping marketing strategy at the highest levels of the organization
Bring a customer-obsessed lens to every decision, constantly asking how initiatives affect the real, lived experience of Vivint customers
Operate as a self-starter — identifying problems before they're assigned, and building solutions with minimal oversight
Thrive on complexity, seeking out the hardest marketing problems rather than avoiding them

What You'll Bring

A track record as a strategic marketing leader with experience shaping and influencing strategy at the executive level
Deep expertise in retention, engagement, and lifecycle marketing, with a portfolio of programs that moved real business metrics
A sharp eye for connecting brand insight to customer strategy
Strong creative instincts paired with the rigor to execute at scale
A customer-obsessed mindset — you default to the customer's point of view in every decision
Comfort operating autonomously in ambiguity, and confidence to challenge ideas (including your own) in pursuit of the best outcome
Genuine excitement for solving complex, multi-layered marketing problems

Why Vivint

Join Vivint at a defining moment — as we integrate with NRG and reimagine what loyalty looks like for millions of smart home customers. This role comes with real influence over strategy, real ownership of the customer journey, and the chance to build retention programs that will shape the company's future.

Description

Team: RamseyTrusted - Real Estate & Tax

Please note that applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Location: Franklin, TN—on-site, relocation assistance available, flexible schedules available

A Little Bit About Us: You might know us from our founder and CEO, Dave Ramsey, who's given no-nonsense money advice on the radio since 1992. Three decades later, Ramsey Solutions is a household name in personal finance, with a mission to change the toxic money culture for good.

Our Mission: Ramsey Solutions provides biblically based, commonsense education and empowerment that give HOPE to everyone in every walk of life.

Here's a Taste Of Our Benefits

Health insurance (includes plans eligible for an HSA—with a company match up to $500!)
401(k) retirement plan with 4% match/company contribution
Annual wellness, counseling and grocery membership reimbursement
On-campus cafe with subsidized pricing for breakfast, lunch and coffee bar
Dependent care FSA
Tons of cultural activities, like weekly devotional, leadership development courses, Battle of the Bands, and one epic Christmas party!

Where And How You'd Work

Ramsey Solutions Headquarters is located just outside of Nashville in Franklin, Tennessee. We value our strong, unified company culture because we believe the best work is done together. That's why all of our team members work on-site under the same roof. But work-life balance is also important to us, so we offer flexible work schedules to take the stress out of appointments, family obligations and other needs that may pop up.

While every team member has a designated workspace (with an electronic sit-stand desk), our campus was designed to house a variety of unique work and play zones (e.g., quiet library space, coffee bar/lounge areas, recreational game zone, and outside/patio work and break areas).

What You'd Do In This Role

Copy that moves people to act is rare, and this role produces it. You'll own the writing for a close-knit marketing squad that helps people find trusted experts who serve them well, crafting short-form pieces like emails, landing pages, paid ads, video scripts, and podcast promotions. You'll build campaigns alongside marketers, designers, and paid media specialists, test what works, and sharpen your craft with performance data. The work matters because the mission does: every message you write guides someone toward the right help at the right time.

You're Probably a Match If

You have 3+ years of professional experience writing marketing and advertising copy yourself, and a portfolio of short-form work to show for it.
You write in a conversational, human voice and can flex your style across audiences, channels, and campaign types.
You've written across paid and organic media, social, email, landing pages, and video scripts.
Your copy drives measurable outcomes like engagement, conversions, and revenue.
You use AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude in your writing workflow and can share real examples of how.
You thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional squad, give and receive feedback well, and don't shy away from healthy conflict.
You start every project by understanding the business goal, not just the brief.

What Winning Looks Like

Writing brand-aligned copy that captures Ramsey's voice, strikes the right emotion, and moves people to take the next step.
Partnering with marketing and paid media teammates to optimize copy based on performance data.

Using AI to generate fresh ideas and check work against brand standards while keeping the thinking firmly your own.

We actually hate debt. We actually cut up our credit cards . . . like, for real. Some of us are still fighting our way out of debt, but we aren't going back. If you don't know much about Ramsey Solutions and our founder, Dave Ramsey, we encourage you to download the Ramsey Network mobile app and consume our content.

The Role

Proofpoint seeks a strategic and innovative Staff Product Marketing Manager to join the Data Security Product Marketing team, supporting a broad portfolio spanning Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Insider Threat Management (ITM), and data security for AI. You’ll define how things get built, not follow someone else’s playbook. Six principles guide how the team works:

📈 1% Better Every Day: small, compounding improvements across everything you ship.
❤️‍🔥 Customer Obsession: start with the customer and work backward.
🚀 Ship Today: bias toward action and iteration over perfection.
🧗 Find a Way: resourcefulness and ambition over constraint.
🤝 Care: be direct, like an honest friend, even when it’s uncomfortable.
🎯 Own It: full accountability, proactive communication, and attention to detail.

About The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Content Marketing Manager to scale GC AI’s content strategy. You’ll lead the editorial direction that shapes how GC AI shows up in the legal, AI, and tech ecosystem, from thought leadership to demand gen to storytelling. This role is equal parts strategist, editor-in-chief, and operator. We’re looking for a sharp, versatile storyteller who can translate complex legal and AI topics into content people actually want to read. We move fast, value clarity over polish, and prioritize content that informs rather than advertises. This role requires legal expertise.

You’ll help set the content agenda, manage execution across multiple channels, and ensure every asset moves the needle on brand credibility, pipeline generation, and customer engagement. You’ll collaborate closely with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Sales, Events, and Product to align content with revenue goals and company narrative.

What You’ll Do

Set Content Strategy: Define and own GC AI’s content strategy, aligning it with GTM priorities and industry trends.
Content Mix: Deliver a balanced mix of long-form content (white papers, reports), short-form thought leadership (LinkedIn posts, blogs), and campaign assets (email, landing pages, ads).
Taste and Craft: Uphold high editorial standards for clarity, precision, and restraint. Ensure GC AI’s content feels sophisticated, useful, personal, and unmistakably “ours.”
Editorial Leadership: Build and maintain a quarterly editorial calendar that supports awareness, demand gen, and customer marketing.
SEO and AEO partnership. Work with the digital/SEO+AEO lead to turn keyword and prompt opportunities into content.
Distribution and Amplification: Oversee cross-channel distribution (email, social, website, partner syndication) and ensure every piece is tracked and optimized for reach and impact.
Thought Leadership Engine: Elevate GC AI’s voice in the in-house legal community by producing high-value articles, white papers, op-eds, and bylined content.
Contributor Management: Commission and manage external contributors, subject-matter experts, and guest authors while ensuring consistency in tone, brand voice, and quality.
Quality and brand voice. Protect the voice. Every piece adheres to guidelines and hits a quality bar.
Measurement. Track performance: engagement, captures, pipeline contribution, share of voice.
Cross-functional support. Partner with PMM (positioning), DG (campaigns), corporate comms (PR), and the executive team (thought leadership).
Process & Operations: Manage editorial workflow, review cycles, and content library. Scale processes to support rapid growth.

What You'll Bring

A legal background is required
Proven track record of developing and scaling content strategies that drive brand authority and measurable pipeline impact.
Exceptional editorial instincts and writing/editing skills.
Experience commissioning and managing contributors, thought leaders, or SMEs.
Strong ability to write about a technical product.
Ability to juggle multiple initiatives, stakeholders, and deadlines.
Proven success partnering with sales, product, events, and PR.
Bonus: Executive ghostwriting or publishing in legal/regulated industries.

A Note On Pace

We’re building something new in a once-in-a-generation shift in technology and the legal industry, so we move at a relentless pace. We expect urgency, ownership, and good judgment even when things aren’t perfectly clear. If you need structure and consensus to do your best work, this isn’t the right place for you. If you thrive in ambiguity and growth, work with intensity, and want real responsibility, keep reading. We’re excited to meet you.

If you’re in a location without an office, expect up to 10% travel (and more for customer-facing roles).

Team members in the San Francisco Bay Area and Provo, UT (within 50 miles of the office) work together on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. As we grow, we plan to establish permanent offices in more hub cities , and we will look to our team members to help build that in-person culture. We currently hire across the United States and Canada.

Perks & Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

— Comprehensive coverage for you and your family

❤️ Life & Disability Insurance
— Added protection when you need it most

💰 Retirement Plan
— Plan and save for your future

— Time to focus on what matters most

— Up to $3,000/year
for job-related learning & development

— DoorDash credits for breakfast, lunch & dinner

— 15 PTO days + 5 sick days
, with opportunities to accrue more

— 15 company holidays + 3 additional “Me Days”

💻 Home Office Setup
— $500
for new hires to build out their workspace

📱 Cell Phone Reimbursement
— $50/month
toward your phone bill

🚚 Relocation Support
— Assistance to help make your move easier

Equal Opportunity Employment

GC AI is an equal opportunity employer that supports workplace diversity and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity/expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other protected class. GC AI is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities.

Fraud Notice to GC AI Applicants

To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that GC AI only accepts job applications through our official careers page at https://gc.ai/careers and through sponsored jobs on LinkedIn. All legitimate communication from our team regarding job opportunities will come from a GC AI team member with a @gc.ai or @getgc.ai email address.

Refer you to external websites to apply
Conduct interviews over email, chat platforms, or messaging apps

jobs.title: Director, Marketing Strategy
jobs.description:
SmartBug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.

We didn't get here by accident. SmartBug has built a reputation that most agencies only aspire to: HubSpot North American Partner of the Year, a fully remote team of specialists who punch well above their weight, and a client base that doesn't just hire us — they stay with us. That last part is the one we're most proud of.

Remote by design and strategic by nature, we've never believed that great work requires a corner office or a campus cafeteria. What it requires is the right people, deeply aligned on outcomes, working with clients who trust them to deliver. That's the culture we've built — one where expertise travels, relationships run deep, and the work speaks for itself.

We're obsessed with client outcomes. Not vanity metrics. Not feel-good reports. Real, measurable growth that makes our clients look like heroes inside their own organizations. When SmartBug is in your corner, your team wins — and that's exactly why our clients keep coming back.

We're growing, our client portfolio is expanding, and the relationships we've built are stronger than ever. What we need next is a leader who understands that the hardest part of this business isn't winning clients — it's becoming so embedded in their success that leaving simply isn't an option. If you've built that kind of loyalty before, if you know what it takes to transform a good client relationship into a decade-long partnership, and if you're energized by the idea of architecting that function at scale — we want to meet you.

About The Role

The Director, Strategy is a high-impact business consultant responsible for defining the overarching vision

and multi-service roadmap for SmartBug's medium and large accounts. While Marketing Strategy remains

the primary engine of growth and the core of the client's strategic focus, this role brings the business

acumen to factor in cross-functional approaches—such as AI, Web, PR, and technical integrations—to

create a unified competitive advantage.

As the final touchpoint for strategic deliverables, the Director ensures that every plan is sophisticated,

integrated, and aligned with the client's long-term business objectives. The Director provides high-level

vision and relies on a team of Strategists and Specialists to handle day-to-day execution.

The Director, Strategy Will Be Measured On

Strategic Excellence: Quality and innovation of the overall marketing and business roadmap.
Sales Impact: Contribution to closing and correctly scoping large and medium accounts.
Client Satisfaction: Long-term results, ROI attainment, and executive-level trust, including the

ability to communicate with C-level executives on client accounts.

Pod Performance: Success and professional development of the team members in the pod.

What You'll Do

Integrated Marketing & Business Strategy

Marketing-Led Vision: Act as the primary architect of the client's marketing engine, ensuring demand generation, brand positioning, and content strategy are the core drivers of ROI.
Cross-Functional Synthesis: Evaluate how non-marketing business functions (e.g., AI automation, technical API integrations, and PR-led authority) can be leveraged to amplify the core marketing strategy.
Full-Lifecycle Alignment: Ensure the marketing strategy seamlessly transitions into sales enablement and customer success, creating a closed-loop system that factors in the entire business operation.
Service Ecosystem Orchestration: Move beyond "HubSpot-only" thinking to determine when a client requires specialized services like web development or advanced data integrations to remove friction from the marketing funnel.

Strategic Governance & Vision

Quarterly Steering: Lead high-impact strategic sessions with client executives to pivot the vision based on market trends, ensuring marketing efforts remain agile and business-relevant.
Final Strategic Touchpoint: Review and refine all major strategic deliverables to ensure they reflect a holistic business perspective before they reach the client.
Strategic ROI Benchmarking: Define how marketing KPIs translate into broader business outcomes like Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) and overall revenue growth.

Sales Growth & Collaboration

Strategic Scoping: Partner with the Sales team to identify gaps where a client's core marketing goals could be better supported by PR, AI, or technical services, ensuring the initial scope is comprehensive.
Vision Selling: Assist sales reps by articulating the "Total SmartBug Advantage," showing prospects how marketing strategy acts as the foundation for a wider business transformation.

Required Qualifications

Minimum of 8 years in digital strategy or business consulting, with a focus on cross-departmental integration
Business acumen to converse with C-suite executives about business goals, not just marketing tactics
Consultative maturity to steer C-suite conversations away from tactical "to-do lists"; toward high-level business strategy and resource allocation
Familiarity with how PR, SEO, Web Development, and AI tools integrate into a modern marketing and sales engine
Proven ability to provide high-level vision while trusting and empowering a team to handle the execution
Deep understanding of the HubSpot ecosystem and how third-party tools integrate to drive growth
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
Experience working directly in a HubSpot partner agency

The Pay Range For This Role Is

95,000 - 110,000 USD per year (Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Sales And Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Sales & Marketing Specialist — Role & Attribution

1. Primary Responsibility

Acquire new customers for UhYea through effective sales and marketing activities.

UhYea provides guided instructions, audience intelligence, recommended marketing channels, suggested marketing materials, and unique trackable URLs. These resources help operators identify promising opportunities and execute their work effectively without having to conduct all the underlying research themselves.

The recommendations are guidance, not restrictions. Operators may use the provided materials as-is, improve them, rewrite them, or create their own when they believe a different approach will be more effective.

2. Marketing Judgment & Performance

Marketing materials and instructions may occasionally be incomplete, inaccurate, vague, ineffective, or awkwardly worded. Operators are expected to exercise their own judgment when deciding how to use or improve them.

The objective is effective customer acquisition, not blind adherence to a script. Better messaging, stronger engagement, and more effective execution can create greater opportunities to generate traffic, conversions, and earnings.

3. Customer Attribution & Ongoing Commissions

Each operator receives a unique trackable URL to identify customers they acquire.

When a new customer signs up through an operator's assigned URL, that customer is attributed to the operator as their original acquisition. This attribution remains exclusive and is not reassigned to another operator because of subsequent visits, marketing exposure, or purchases through other channels.

For as long as the operator remains with UhYea, they are eligible to earn commissions on that customer's qualifying purchases under the program's compensation rules.

Customer retention, repeat-purchase opportunities, pricing, and continued funnel activity are managed by UhYea. The operator is rewarded for the initial acquisition that brought the customer into the business.

4. Performance Beyond Direct Acquisition

Not every marketing interaction results in a newly attributed customer. For example, an operator may generate clicks, traffic, or other valuable engagement from people who are already UhYea customers.

These activities can still contribute value to the business. Operators may therefore have opportunities to earn through qualifying performance beyond directly acquiring new customers, subject to the applicable performance and compensation rules.

5. Operating Autonomy & Tracking

Operators choose how to execute their marketing activities within applicable program rules and laws. UhYea's tracking system handles customer attribution and purchase tracking automatically, so operators do not need to submit manual reports or guess which purchases qualify.

Operators must use their assigned trackable URLs for new-customer acquisition to be credited correctly. Existing customers retain their original attribution, regardless of where they encounter subsequent marketing.

6. Compensation Principles

- Customer acquisition is rewarded because bringing a new customer into the business is a valuable contribution.
- Qualifying repeat purchases from an operator's attributed customers can continue generating commissions while the operator remains with UhYea.
- Additional qualifying performance may provide earning opportunities when an operator contributes to traffic or marketing activity without acquiring a new customer.
- Commissions are subject to qualifying-purchase requirements, the applicable refund grace period, and program rules.
- There are no guaranteed hours or earnings.

The Director directly manages and develops a team of three a Patient Experience Marketer, an HCP Experience Marketer, and a PharmD Fellow bringing strong people leadership, strategic thinking, and rare disease commercial expertise to the role.

This includes building internal digital capabilities, owning content and campaign production digitally, and systematically reducing reliance on external creative and media agencies over time positioning this portfolio as a model for digital-first, agile brand marketing within Sanofi Rare Disease.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and Specialty Care neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, youll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

Were an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving peoples lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve peoples lives.

Develop and maintain the strategic framework for the ASMD and MPS I portfolio, including portfolio prioritization, lifecycle management, and competitive response strategies

Ensure brand strategies are grounded in data, customer insights, competitive intelligence, and clinical data, addressing the full patient journey

jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Strategist
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are hiring a senior, hands-on paid media strategist to independently own and improve campaign performance across Meta and Google Ads. You will build and optimize accounts, diagnose changes, develop and run tests, and make recommendations grounded in our clients' business objectives. You need to understand how the platforms actually work: what drives delivery, what limits performance, what signals they depend on, and when a proposed tactic will not work as intended. The founder will contribute business context and overall creative direction, but should not have to identify every problem, devise every test, or chase the next step.

Responsibilities
Own hands-on campaign strategy and execution across Meta and Google Ads for multiple clients, including account structure, launches, ongoing optimization, budget pacing, and performance accountability.
Monitor account health proactively. Investigate meaningful changes in spend, CPC, conversion rate, lead volume, qualified leads, cost per acquisition, revenue, and ROAS rather than waiting for problems to be flagged.
Analyze results rigorously. Choose relevant comparisons, examine change history and search terms, account for attribution delays and small samples, and distinguish plausible explanations from conclusions supported by evidence. Know when to act and when to wait.
Develop, prioritize, and execute meaningful tests across campaign types, keywords and match types, bidding, audiences, budgets, creative, and landing pages. Define hypotheses, risks, success criteria, and what to do with the findings.
Make decisions around the client's business objectives, not just the lowest CPL or highest ROAS. Recognize when growth requires more qualified leads, new demand, higher spend, or a different acquisition approach.
Use deep platform expertise to explain how auctions, automation, learning, targeting limits, placements, and conversion signals affect performance. Challenge impractical suggestions constructively and recommend workable alternatives.
Investigate gaps between platform conversions and actual outcomes, including forms, calls, booked appointments, sales, and CRM stages. Work with technical specialists on tracking, attribution, and landing-page issues and verify fixes.
Own paid-media launch and account QA: check budgets, campaign settings, targeting, exclusions, creative, destination URLs, conversion events, schedules, and Google Merchant Center or catalog feeds where relevant.
Communicate clear, decision-ready updates: what changed, what may have caused it, what you recommend, what you did, and how you will evaluate the result. Contribute confidently to internal and client performance discussions.

Requirements
6+ years of hands-on paid media experience, preferably in an agency managing multiple accounts, with demonstrated results across lead generation and ecommerce.
Expert Google Ads skills across Search, Performance Max, Shopping, and YouTube/Demand Gen as relevant. Deep command of search intent, match types, bidding, budgets, account structure, and conversion strategy.
Expert Meta Ads skills across campaign structure, audiences, placements, creative testing, automated delivery, retargeting, and conversion signals.
Proven independent ownership of account performance. You can explain decisions you made, tests you ran, trade-offs you evaluated, and what changed as a result.
Advanced analytical judgment: able to diagnose underperformance, design informative tests, spot misleading comparisons, account for attribution and sample-size limits, and avoid confusing correlation with causation.
Commercial judgment about qualified leads, bookings, sales conversion, acquisition costs, revenue, and ROAS. Able to balance efficient spending with each client's growth objectives.
Practical fluency with GA4, GTM, Google and Meta conversion tracking, enhanced conversions, Meta Pixel/CAPI, UTMs, CRM and offline conversions, and Merchant Center. Able to diagnose technical issues without necessarily coding fixes.
Sound judgment about ad messaging, creative, and landing pages. Able to identify what may be limiting response and give useful testing direction to copy, design, video, and web specialists.
Self-directed, organized, and reliable. Keeps accounts moving, follows through on investigations, and brings recommendations before being asked. Stays current with platform changes, welcomes feedback, and respectfully challenges assumptions.
Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate evidence, uncertainty, and platform limitations clearly. Full-time remote availability with substantial overlap with U.S. Central Time.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Go-to-Market (GTM) Product Marketing Manager, Portfolio and Expansion
jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Product Marketing and Enablement connects 1Password’s product strategy to the customer conversations that drive growth. In this Senior Staff individual contributor role, you’ll own the product-to-field motion for Unified Access, Software as a Service (SaaS) Manager, and multi-product expansion, helping Account Executives (AEs), Sales Engineers (SEs), and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) connect the needs of Information Technology (IT), security, finance, and executive buyers to the right solutions. Through clear cross-product storytelling, sales guidance, and close partnership with Product and Sales, you’ll help 1Password advance its mission to unleash employee productivity without compromising security. Reporting to the Director, Product Marketing and Enablement, this role is remote across the United States and Canada.

How We’re Using AI Today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

A track record of bringing complex technical Business-to-Business (B2B) products, new use cases, or emerging categories to market, with the ability to build product motions spanning discovery, evaluation, technical validation, purchase, adoption, and expansion.
Familiarity with sales-led enterprise organizations, including complex buying cycles, Account Executives (AEs), Sales Engineers (SEs), technical buyers, and multi-threaded customer opportunities.
Cross-functional leadership across Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and Go-to-Market (GTM) Enablement, with credibility among Information Technology (IT), security, finance, and executive audiences.
Deep fluency in multi-product enterprise software, Software as a Service (SaaS) management, or platform narratives, along with working knowledge of enterprise IT, cross-sell motions, and value-based selling.
The ability to translate technical product behavior into clear enablement content that addresses customer problems, key use cases, and business value; collaborate effectively with Product and Engineering subject-matter experts; and earn the trust of SEs and technical buyers.
Strategic leadership with limited supervision, including shaping portfolio priorities, readiness roadmaps, operating practices, and measurement approaches; influencing senior leaders without formal authority; and making thoughtful trade-offs in ambiguous environments.
Strong written and verbal communication across technical, commercial, and executive audiences, including the ability to explain complex products in plain English, develop compelling narratives, maintain a clear point of view, and update recommendations when the evidence changes. You also use artificial intelligence (AI) thoughtfully to accelerate research, analysis, and content development while retaining ownership of strategy, judgment, and quality.
Exposure to launching products, categories, or sales motions in SaaS management, enterprise platforms, cross-sell, or related markets; working with cross-functional buying groups and multi-threaded enterprise deals; using field data, call insights, win-loss feedback, or seller research to prioritize execution; or holding security certifications or equivalent technical training.

What You Can Expect

Own the product enablement plan for Unified Access, SaaS Manager, and multi-product expansion, prioritizing readiness work based on business impact, customer needs, launches, and field evidence.
Own the Unified Access field narrative, master deck, pitch decks, talk tracks, qualification questions, discovery guidance, and product training that help sellers tell one connected story.
Adapt the Unified Access and SaaS Manager stories for IT, security, finance, and executive buyers, translating product capabilities into clear customer and business value.
Define how the products fit into cross-sell, upmarket, and multi-product sales plays, including expansion from the Enterprise Password Manager base and strategies for multi-threading opportunities.
Act as an escalation point for strategic opportunities, join live customer conversations, support discovery and demos, and coach sellers through complex technical questions and objections.
Equip CSMs with the stories and guidance they need to drive cross-sell, adoption, and expansion across the portfolio.
Partner with Technical Marketing and Demo Engineering to map demos to sales plays, then use field feedback, win-loss analysis, and customer insights to improve product decisions, messaging, launches, and enablement.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $180,000 USD and $261,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $152,000 CAD and $220,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. Collaborative, analytical, and execution-focused, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive measurable business impact.

Competitive compensation
Comprehensive benefits
Career success on your terms
Flexible work environment
Annual wellness and community outreach days
