jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Go-to-Market (GTM) Product Marketing Manager, Access Security
jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Product Marketing and Enablement connects 1Password’s product strategy to the customer conversations that drive growth. In this Senior Staff individual contributor role, you’ll own the product-to-field motion for Enterprise Password Manager (EPM), Agentic Access—including Developer Tools—and Privileged Access, helping Account Executives (AEs), Sales Engineers (SEs), and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) connect the needs of Information Technology (IT), security, and engineering teams to the right solutions. Through clear technical storytelling, credible sales guidance, and close partnership with Product and Sales, you’ll help 1Password advance its mission to unleash employee productivity without compromising security. Reporting to the Director, Product Marketing and Enablement, this role is remote across the United States and Canada.

How We’re Using AI Today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

Experience bringing complex technical Business-to-Business (B2B) products, new use cases, or emerging categories to market.
Experience working in a sales-led organization with enterprise sellers, Sales Engineers, technical buyers, and complex buying cycles.
Experience building a product motion across discovery, evaluation, technical validation, purchase, and expansion.
Experience partnering across Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and GTM Enablement, with the ability to build credibility with technical and executive audiences.
Deep fluency in identity security, Privileged Access Management (PAM), secrets management, or agentic access, along with working knowledge of developer tools and the ability to translate technical product behavior into clear customer-facing guidance.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, strategic judgment, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders while making thoughtful decisions in ambiguous environments.
Experience launching a new product, category, or sales motion in identity security, access management, developer tools, or a related technical market; using field insights, win-loss feedback, or seller research to prioritize work; or holding security certifications or equivalent technical training.

What You Can Expect

Own the product enablement plan for Enterprise Password Manager, Agentic Access—including Developer Tools—and Privileged Access, prioritizing readiness work based on business impact, customer needs, launches, and field evidence.
Translate Product Marketing strategy into sales motions that help IT, security, and engineering buyers secure access for developers, artificial intelligence (AI) agents, and privileged users.
Create the pitch decks, talk tracks, qualification questions, discovery guides, product training, and other field assets needed to support customer conversations from discovery through expansion.
Define how the portfolio fits into annual sales plays, including the personas to engage at each stage of the buying journey and the role of strategic technology and AI partnerships.
Act as an escalation point for strategic opportunities, join live customer conversations, support discovery and demos, and coach sellers through complex technical questions and objections.
Partner with Technical Marketing and Demo Engineering to map demos to sales plays and provide the customer, use-case, and product context needed to build credible launch and sales demonstrations.
Measure field readiness, lead win-loss analysis, identify recurring objections and adoption barriers, and bring clear recommendations to Product, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and senior leadership.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $180,000 USD and $261,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $152,000 CAD and $220,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through creating dynamic, high-performing, and globally scalable experiences, you will directly boost our go-to-market efforts and support our internal teams.
This role is perfect for an AI-forward engineering leader who thrives where technology, growth marketing, and data converge. Operating at a Staff/Lead level, you will partner closely with Growth, Marketing Operations, and Data teams to invent scalable solutions. These solutions will allow fast experimentation, increase user acquisition, and gather actionable analytics. You will lead by example through hands-on coding, system development, and cross-functional leadership. Job title:Global HCP Marketing Lead, Duvakitug (IBD)

Location: Cambridge, MA

About The Job

Join the team transforming care for people with immune-mediated and inflammatory diseases. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

Sanofi's Immunology Franchise is preparing to transform the treatment landscape for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) with duvakitug, one of Sanofi's high-priority new assets. As the Global HCP Marketing Lead, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the healthcare professional (HCP) marketing strategy from prelaunch through launch and beyond. This is a unique opportunity to build a comprehensive omnichannel marketing program for a potentially groundbreaking therapy in a disease area with significant unmet medical need and a rapidly evolving competitive landscape.

Reporting directly to the Global Brand Lead, you will be responsible for developing disease state awareness, defining HCP segmentation and engagement strategies, crafting compelling HCP messaging, and deploying innovative marketing campaigns that leverage cutting-edge technologies including AI-enabled solutions. You will work closely with key markets, including the US and Japan, and serve as the lead for the Agency of Record (AOR) relationship, ensuring strategic alignment and executional excellence across all HCP marketing activities.

As the team continues to grow in anticipation of launch, this role offers a rare opportunity to help build something meaningful from the ground up working at the intersection of science, strategy, and creativity to ensure gastroenterologists, IBD specialists, and other relevant HCPs are informed, engaged, and equipped to identify and treat patients living with IBD.

This product will be developed and marketed in collaboration with Teva with Sanofi responsible for launches outside of the EU.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and Specialty Care neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, youll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi

Were an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving peoples lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve peoples lives.

Main Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

Own the global HCP marketing strategy for duvakitug in IBD across prelaunch and launch, grounded in treatment-landscape, competitive, and customer insights

Align cross-functional partners (Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Advocacy, Market Research) and key markets (notably US, Japan) on integrated, locally adapted execution

Act as the thought leader on IBD HCP marketing for senior leadership

HCP Segmentation & Targeting

Build and refine HCP segmentation (prescribing behavior, specialty, patient mix, engagement preferences) to guide targeting and resource allocation

Translate segmentation into actionable, omnichannel campaign plans, adjusting as the HCP landscape evolves

Disease Awareness, KOL & Advisory Strategy

Design disease-state awareness campaigns and educational content to close HCP knowledge gaps in IBD diagnosis and management

Lead the commercial KOL engagement strategy (identification, mapping, cultivation) and partner with medical societies/patient advocacy to extend reach

Plan and facilitate Advisory Boards and Strategic Steering Committees, synthesizing input into strategic recommendations

Build lasting, trust-based KOL relationships supporting brand advocacy

HCP Campaigns, Messaging & Agency Management

Develop evidence-based messaging and integrated omnichannel campaigns (digital, in-person, hybrid) for gastroenterologists, IBD specialists, and other prescribers

Oversee promotional/non-promotional materials, ensuring regulatory, legal, and medical compliance

Lead the Agency of Record relationship end-to-end: briefs, budget, performance evaluation, and fostering an agile, high-performing partnership

Omnichannel Innovation & Insights

Design seamless, personalized omnichannel HCP experiences, applying AI and analytics to targeting, personalization, and channel optimization

Pilot emerging digital tools (AI, predictive analytics, virtual platforms) to keep duvakitug's HCP program at the industry forefront

Partner with Market Research and Competitive Intelligence to build a continuous insights framework informing strategy, messaging, and campaigns

Performance, Budget & Cross-Functional Partnership

Define KPIs and measurement frameworks to track campaign, engagement, and brand performance; report insights to senior leadership

Manage HCP marketing budgets with rigor and accountability

Serve as marketing liaison to Medical Affairs (scientific accuracy), Market Access (value messaging), and Patient Advocacy (patient voice integration)

Partner with Teva counterparts to ensure alignment and consistent execution across Sanofi and Teva markets

About You

Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Marketing, Business, or related field; advanced degree (MBA, PharmD, or PhD) preferred

8+ years of progressive pharmaceutical/biotech marketing experience, including HCP marketing in specialty care gastroenterology, immunology, or related therapeutic areas preferred

Experience leading prelaunch and launch marketing for innovative therapies, including building marketing capabilities from the ground up

Strong grasp of omnichannel marketing and digital HCP engagement, with experience applying AI technologies in pharmaceutical marketing

Experience planning/facilitating advisory boards and strategic steering committees, and engaging KOLs in a commercial context

Proven agency management skills (briefing, budget oversight, performance management)

Solid knowledge of pharmaceutical regulatory and promotional review processes

Demonstrated ability to build strategic marketing plans and translate them into actionable, measurable campaigns

Background in gastroenterology, IBD, or related inflammatory/autoimmune and biologics markets, with familiarity with the IBD treatment landscape (standard of care and emerging therapies) preferred

Experience navigating complex specialty-care treatment landscapes

Track record of successful disease awareness campaign development and execution

Global marketing experience across diverse markets/cultures, including the US and Japan

Why Choose Us

Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether its through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks gender-neutral parental leave.

At Amgen, if you feel like youre part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do.

As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Marketing Senior Manager, UPLIZNA gMG Medical Marketing

Live

What you will do

Lets do this. Lets change the world. The Senior Manager, Neurology Medical Marketing - Opinion Leader Engagement & Peer-to-Peer (P2P) will lead the U.S. Neurology opinion leader (OL) engagement and P2P strategy, UPLIZNA Speaker Bureau, and marketing-led HCP education and engagement portfolio across gMG and NMOSD. Reporting to the Neuro Medical Marketing Lead, this individual will translate franchise and indication priorities into an integrated external engagement model that strengthens strategic relationships, customer confidence, brand differentiation, and high-quality field execution.

This role has end-to-end accountability for marketing-led OL engagement and P2P, including OL mapping and engagement planning, speaker programs, Peer Discussion Groups, industry therapeutic updates (ITUs), product theaters, symposia, speaker development, P2P content, and agency/vendor delivery. The Senior Manager will lead and develop direct reports who pull through assigned workstreams and partner closely with HCP Marketing, Medical Affairs, Field Medical, Sales, TLLs, Training, Regulatory, Legal, Market Access, Global, Professional Marketing, and other cross-functional colleagues. Advisory boards and other primary insight-generation forums are led by the Insights & Congress Strategy organization; this role translates those learnings into engagement plans.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Opinion Leader Engagement and P2P Strategy

Set and evolve the U.S. Neurology OL engagement and P2P strategy across gMG and NMOSD, aligning marketing-led HCP education and engagement with franchise priorities, customer needs, scientific developments, competitive dynamics, and lifecycle objectives.

Own OL mapping, segmentation, and engagement planning for established and emerging OLs, in partnership with Medical Affairs, Field Medical, TLLs, and HCP Marketing.

Establish clear engagement objectives, audience segmentation, deployment plans, and success measures for the portfolio; ensure each activity is appropriately aligned to customer, indication, and business needs.

Lead annual and in-year P2P and OL engagement planning, including program volume, geographic deployment, investment allocation, and contingency planning across both indications.

Own and Evolve the UPLIZNA Speaker Bureau and P2P Portfolio

Own the strategy, design, and execution of the UPLIZNA Speaker Bureau, including bureau composition, speaker segmentation, recruitment, onboarding, contracting coordination, activation, and ongoing optimization.

Own the end-to-end design and execution of marketing-led HCP education and P2P programs, including speaker programs, Peer Discussion Groups, ITUs, and other approved customer education opportunities.

Lead speaker training and development strategy, including curriculum design, content readiness, faculty preparation, and ongoing capability building for new and tenured speakers.

Partner with Sales Training and field leadership to strengthen field readiness, appropriate program pull-through, and a consistent customer experience.

Lead Opinion Leader Engagement at Congresses

Own all marketing-led OL-facing engagement at congresses, including ITUs, symposia, product theaters, speaker and faculty activity, and other approved OL-present programs.

Set the strategy, objectives, and engagement plans for the OL-facing congress workstream; lead and direct the team members responsible for detailed planning and on-site pull-through.

Partner with the TLL team to identify and coordinate priority OL engagements for the Neuro Medical Marketing Lead, other leaders, and cross-functional partners before and during congresses; ensure agreed follow-up actions are completed after the event.

Partner with the Insights & Congress Strategy lead to integrate OL engagement plans into sponsorship choices, the broader congress activation strategy, and post-congress learning. Partner with Professional Marketing to align OL-facing programs with its booth-related and sales-driven assets.

Build Content and Deliver High-Quality Execution

Own development and lifecycle management of P2P materials, including speaker decks, disease-state resources, case-based materials, and program tools; oversee agency development, MAC review, approval, rollout, and updates.

Ensure P2P content and speaker training clearly communicate the scientific and clinical rationale for UPLIZNA while meeting the distinct needs of gMG and NMOSD customers.

Manage P2P and OL engagement budgets, agencies, and external vendors with strong financial stewardship, rigorous prioritization, and accountability for timely, high-quality delivery.

Ensure high-quality execution across the portfolio by setting clear operating models, timelines, decision rights, and standards for program planning, vendor management, compliance, and follow-up.

Drive Performance, Insights, and Cross-Functional Alignment

Define and monitor meaningful measures of P2P, Speaker Bureau, and OL engagement performance, including program quality, reach, utilization, speaker effectiveness, audience feedback, and strategic impact.

Translate field feedback, customer insights, program data, competitive intelligence, and external engagement learnings into clear recommendations to improve OL engagement strategy, P2P content, and execution.

Contribute to annual brand planning, long-range planning, quarterly priorities, and tactical plans by bringing forward customer, scientific, and performance implications.

Represent OL Engagement and P2P Medical Marketing in key franchise forums and communicate performance, emerging risks, opportunities, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

Directly lead, coach, and develop team members responsible for P2P execution and related Medical Marketing workstreams; establish clear priorities, decision rights, accountability, and development plans.

Create an operating model that balances strategic leadership with disciplined execution, enabling the team to manage complex workstreams while maintaining a strong customer and business focus.

Foster a culture of scientific curiosity, customer centricity, ownership, collaboration, innovation, and high standards of execution. Live and role model Amgen Values across the UPLIZNA brand team and cross-functional partners.

Win

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The strategic professional we seek is a motivated individual with these qualifications.

Doctorate degree and 2 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR

Master's degree and 4 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR

Bachelor's degree and 6 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR

Associate's degree and 10 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR

High school diploma / GED and 12 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization.

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

Demonstrated direct people-management experience, including coaching and developing talent, setting priorities, and leading through change.

Strong Medical Marketing, OL engagement, and P2P expertise, including OL mapping and engagement planning, Speaker Bureau operations, speaker training, marketing-led HCP education, promotional content development, and multichannel education.

Experience leading P2P and marketing-led OL/HCP engagements end-to-end, including congress-based programs, speaker strategy, faculty management, program design, agency/vendor management, budget oversight, performance optimization, and MAC review through systems such as Veeva PromoMats.

Strong strategic thinking, operational rigor, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to lead through influence and deliver across complex, cross-functional workstreams.

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, well support your journey every step of the way.

Collaborate directly with leadership and product teams to develop and implement marketing ideas, adapting priorities as the business evolves.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful marketer with proven content creation and SEO capabilities, practical experience using AI in everyday workflows, and the ability to work independently in an evolving environment. The following qualifications are expected:

Hands-on experience using AI agents, automation tools, integrations, and advanced AI workflows to complete real marketing tasks.
Strong writing and editing skills, with examples of clear, useful content, preferably covering technical subjects.
Demonstrated experience in SEO, including measurable results from previous initiatives.
Familiarity with GEO and AEO, including an understanding of how AI-generated recommendations and answers differ from traditional search results.
Experience developing and managing partnerships or collaborations with bloggers, content creators, authors, or other businesses.
Experience marketing technical products, ideally software, SaaS, WordPress, or related technologies.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to use performance data to assess results and guide decisions.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Team: RamseyTrusted - Real Estate & Tax

Please note that applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Location: Franklin, TN—on-site, relocation assistance available, flexible schedules available

A Little Bit About Us: You might know us from our founder and CEO, Dave Ramsey, who's given no-nonsense money advice on the radio since 1992. Three decades later, Ramsey Solutions is a household name in personal finance, with a mission to change the toxic money culture for good.

Our Mission: Ramsey Solutions provides biblically based, commonsense education and empowerment that give HOPE to everyone in every walk of life.

Here's a Taste Of Our Benefits

Health insurance (includes plans eligible for an HSA—with a company match up to $500!)
401(k) retirement plan with 4% match/company contribution
Annual wellness, counseling and grocery membership reimbursement
On-campus cafe with subsidized pricing for breakfast, lunch and coffee bar
Dependent care FSA
Tons of cultural activities, like weekly devotional, leadership development courses, Battle of the Bands, and one epic Christmas party!

Where And How You'd Work

Ramsey Solutions Headquarters is located just outside of Nashville in Franklin, Tennessee. We value our strong, unified company culture because we believe the best work is done together. That's why all of our team members work on-site under the same roof. But work-life balance is also important to us, so we offer flexible work schedules to take the stress out of appointments, family obligations and other needs that may pop up.

While every team member has a designated workspace (with an electronic sit-stand desk), our campus was designed to house a variety of unique work and play zones (e.g., quiet library space, coffee bar/lounge areas, recreational game zone, and outside/patio work and break areas).

What You'd Do In This Role

Copy that moves people to act is rare, and this role produces it. You'll own the writing for a close-knit marketing squad that helps people find trusted experts who serve them well, crafting short-form pieces like emails, landing pages, paid ads, video scripts, and podcast promotions. You'll build campaigns alongside marketers, designers, and paid media specialists, test what works, and sharpen your craft with performance data. The work matters because the mission does: every message you write guides someone toward the right help at the right time.

You're Probably a Match If

You have 3+ years of professional experience writing marketing and advertising copy yourself, and a portfolio of short-form work to show for it.
You write in a conversational, human voice and can flex your style across audiences, channels, and campaign types.
You've written across paid and organic media, social, email, landing pages, and video scripts.
Your copy drives measurable outcomes like engagement, conversions, and revenue.
You use AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude in your writing workflow and can share real examples of how.
You thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional squad, give and receive feedback well, and don't shy away from healthy conflict.
You start every project by understanding the business goal, not just the brief.

What Winning Looks Like

Writing brand-aligned copy that captures Ramsey's voice, strikes the right emotion, and moves people to take the next step.
Partnering with marketing and paid media teammates to optimize copy based on performance data.
Studying customer pain points, marketing journeys, and competitors so every project starts with a clear "why."
Using AI to generate fresh ideas and check work against brand standards while keeping the thinking firmly your own.
Holding your work with an open hand, welcoming feedback, and carrying what you learn from one project to the next.
Contributing to a squad culture of shared ownership by collaborating openly, engaging in healthy conflict, and showing up as a trusted teammate.

Other Stuff To Know

We're looking for people who are passionate about our mission. This isn't just a J-O-B. We experience resistance every day because what we believe is absolutely countercultural. We actually hate debt. We actually cut up our credit cards . . . like, for real. Some of us are still fighting our way out of debt, but we aren't going back. If you don't know much about Ramsey Solutions and our founder, Dave Ramsey, we encourage you to download the Ramsey Network mobile app and consume our content.

If Ramsey Solutions sounds like a workplace where you can get excited about Mondays, apply today. We can't wait to hear from you!

new_jobs.description:
GC AI is the legal intelligence platform built for in-house legal teams and companies. Your decisions shape the product, your impact is immediate, and you own your work from day one.

More than 2,100 companies run their legal work on GC AI, including 300+ public companies, 75+ unicorns, and teams at Nestlé, Hitachi Digital, Lockheed Martin, Miro, Bass Pro Shops, Riot Games, SKIMS, Liquid Death, Vercel, TIME, and Post Holdings. The platform holds an 80 NPS, more than double the B2B SaaS industry average, reinforcing GC AI as the leading legal AI platform for companies of all sizes.

GC AI has doubled ARR in six months. We won #1 Highest Customer Satisfaction at the 2026 SaaS Awards. Our investors include Scale Venture Partners, Northzone, Sound Ventures, and Guillermo Rauch, CEO of Vercel.

You’ll define how things get built, not follow someone else’s playbook. Six principles guide how the team works:

📈 1% Better Every Day: small, compounding improvements across everything you ship.
❤️‍🔥 Customer Obsession: start with the customer and work backward.
🚀 Ship Today: bias toward action and iteration over perfection.
🧗 Find a Way: resourcefulness and ambition over constraint.
🤝 Care: be direct, like an honest friend, even when it’s uncomfortable.
🎯 Own It: full accountability, proactive communication, and attention to detail.

About The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Content Marketing Manager to scale GC AI’s content strategy. You’ll lead the editorial direction that shapes how GC AI shows up in the legal, AI, and tech ecosystem, from thought leadership to demand gen to storytelling. This role is equal parts strategist, editor-in-chief, and operator. We’re looking for a sharp, versatile storyteller who can translate complex legal and AI topics into content people actually want to read. We move fast, value clarity over polish, and prioritize content that informs rather than advertises. This role requires legal expertise.

You’ll help set the content agenda, manage execution across multiple channels, and ensure every asset moves the needle on brand credibility, pipeline generation, and customer engagement. You’ll collaborate closely with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Sales, Events, and Product to align content with revenue goals and company narrative.

What You’ll Do

Set Content Strategy: Define and own GC AI’s content strategy, aligning it with GTM priorities and industry trends.
Content Mix: Deliver a balanced mix of long-form content (white papers, reports), short-form thought leadership (LinkedIn posts, blogs), and campaign assets (email, landing pages, ads).
Taste and Craft: Uphold high editorial standards for clarity, precision, and restraint. Ensure GC AI’s content feels sophisticated, useful, personal, and unmistakably “ours.”
Editorial Leadership: Build and maintain a quarterly editorial calendar that supports awareness, demand gen, and customer marketing.
SEO and AEO partnership. Work with the digital/SEO+AEO lead to turn keyword and prompt opportunities into content.
Distribution and Amplification: Oversee cross-channel distribution (email, social, website, partner syndication) and ensure every piece is tracked and optimized for reach and impact.
Thought Leadership Engine: Elevate GC AI’s voice in the in-house legal community by producing high-value articles, white papers, op-eds, and bylined content.
Contributor Management: Commission and manage external contributors, subject-matter experts, and guest authors while ensuring consistency in tone, brand voice, and quality.
Quality and brand voice. Protect the voice. Every piece adheres to guidelines and hits a quality bar.
Measurement. Track performance: engagement, captures, pipeline contribution, share of voice.
Cross-functional support. Partner with PMM (positioning), DG (campaigns), corporate comms (PR), and the executive team (thought leadership).
Process & Operations: Manage editorial workflow, review cycles, and content library. Scale processes to support rapid growth.

What You'll Bring

A legal background is required
Proven track record of developing and scaling content strategies that drive brand authority and measurable pipeline impact.
Exceptional editorial instincts and writing/editing skills.
Experience commissioning and managing contributors, thought leaders, or SMEs.
Strong ability to write about a technical product.
Ability to juggle multiple initiatives, stakeholders, and deadlines.
Proven success partnering with sales, product, events, and PR.
Bonus: Executive ghostwriting or publishing in legal/regulated industries.

A Note On Pace

We’re building something new in a once-in-a-generation shift in technology and the legal industry, so we move at a relentless pace. We expect urgency, ownership, and good judgment even when things aren’t perfectly clear. If you need structure and consensus to do your best work, this isn’t the right place for you. If you thrive in ambiguity and growth, work with intensity, and want real responsibility, keep reading. We’re excited to meet you.

How We Work Together

GC AI is a distributed company with team members across North America, and soon Europe. We believe that because our business is AI, human connection matters more, not less. We invest in bringing people together through our hub model: regular coworking sessions, customer dinners, team and company offsites. If you’re in a location without an office, expect up to 10% travel (and more for customer-facing roles).

Team members in the San Francisco Bay Area and Provo, UT (within 50 miles of the office) work together on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. As we grow, we plan to establish permanent offices in more hub cities , and we will look to our team members to help build that in-person culture. We currently hire across the United States and Canada.

Perks & Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

🏥 Medical, Dental & Vision
— Comprehensive coverage for you and your family

❤️ Life & Disability Insurance
— Added protection when you need it most

💰 Retirement Plan
— Plan and save for your future

👶 Parental Leave
— Time to focus on what matters most

📚 Continuous Development
— Up to $3,000/year
for job-related learning & development

🍽️ In-Office Meals
— DoorDash credits for breakfast, lunch & dinner

🌴 Paid Time Off
— 15 PTO days + 5 sick days
, with opportunities to accrue more

🎉 Company Holidays
— 15 company holidays + 3 additional “Me Days”

💻 Home Office Setup
— $500
for new hires to build out their workspace

📱 Cell Phone Reimbursement
— $50/month
toward your phone bill

🚚 Relocation Support
— Assistance to help make your move easier

Equal Opportunity Employment

GC AI is an equal opportunity employer that supports workplace diversity and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity/expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other protected class. GC AI is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities.

Fraud Notice to GC AI Applicants

To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that GC AI only accepts job applications through our official careers page at https://gc.ai/careers and through sponsored jobs on LinkedIn. All legitimate communication from our team regarding job opportunities will come from a GC AI team member with a @gc.ai or @getgc.ai email address.

GC AI Will Never

Refer you to external websites to apply
Conduct interviews over email, chat platforms, or messaging apps
Ask you to provide payment or purchase equipment
Request personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers, or banking information during the application process

Examples Of Fraudulent Email Addresses

new_jobs.title: Director, Marketing Strategy
new_jobs.description:
SmartBug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.

We didn't get here by accident. SmartBug has built a reputation that most agencies only aspire to: HubSpot North American Partner of the Year, a fully remote team of specialists who punch well above their weight, and a client base that doesn't just hire us — they stay with us. That last part is the one we're most proud of.

Remote by design and strategic by nature, we've never believed that great work requires a corner office or a campus cafeteria. What it requires is the right people, deeply aligned on outcomes, working with clients who trust them to deliver. That's the culture we've built — one where expertise travels, relationships run deep, and the work speaks for itself.

We're obsessed with client outcomes. Not vanity metrics. Not feel-good reports. Real, measurable growth that makes our clients look like heroes inside their own organizations. When SmartBug is in your corner, your team wins — and that's exactly why our clients keep coming back.

We're growing, our client portfolio is expanding, and the relationships we've built are stronger than ever. What we need next is a leader who understands that the hardest part of this business isn't winning clients — it's becoming so embedded in their success that leaving simply isn't an option. If you've built that kind of loyalty before, if you know what it takes to transform a good client relationship into a decade-long partnership, and if you're energized by the idea of architecting that function at scale — we want to meet you.

About The Role

The Director, Strategy is a high-impact business consultant responsible for defining the overarching vision

and multi-service roadmap for SmartBug's medium and large accounts. While Marketing Strategy remains

the primary engine of growth and the core of the client's strategic focus, this role brings the business

acumen to factor in cross-functional approaches—such as AI, Web, PR, and technical integrations—to

create a unified competitive advantage.

As the final touchpoint for strategic deliverables, the Director ensures that every plan is sophisticated,

integrated, and aligned with the client's long-term business objectives. The Director provides high-level

vision and relies on a team of Strategists and Specialists to handle day-to-day execution.

The Director, Strategy Will Be Measured On

Strategic Excellence: Quality and innovation of the overall marketing and business roadmap.
Sales Impact: Contribution to closing and correctly scoping large and medium accounts.
Client Satisfaction: Long-term results, ROI attainment, and executive-level trust, including the

ability to communicate with C-level executives on client accounts.

Pod Performance: Success and professional development of the team members in the pod.

What You'll Do

Integrated Marketing & Business Strategy

Marketing-Led Vision: Act as the primary architect of the client's marketing engine, ensuring demand generation, brand positioning, and content strategy are the core drivers of ROI.
Cross-Functional Synthesis: Evaluate how non-marketing business functions (e.g., AI automation, technical API integrations, and PR-led authority) can be leveraged to amplify the core marketing strategy.
Full-Lifecycle Alignment: Ensure the marketing strategy seamlessly transitions into sales enablement and customer success, creating a closed-loop system that factors in the entire business operation.
Service Ecosystem Orchestration: Move beyond "HubSpot-only" thinking to determine when a client requires specialized services like web development or advanced data integrations to remove friction from the marketing funnel.

Strategic Governance & Vision

Quarterly Steering: Lead high-impact strategic sessions with client executives to pivot the vision based on market trends, ensuring marketing efforts remain agile and business-relevant.
Final Strategic Touchpoint: Review and refine all major strategic deliverables to ensure they reflect a holistic business perspective before they reach the client.
Strategic ROI Benchmarking: Define how marketing KPIs translate into broader business outcomes like Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) and overall revenue growth.

Sales Growth & Collaboration

Strategic Scoping: Partner with the Sales team to identify gaps where a client's core marketing goals could be better supported by PR, AI, or technical services, ensuring the initial scope is comprehensive.
Vision Selling: Assist sales reps by articulating the "Total SmartBug Advantage," showing prospects how marketing strategy acts as the foundation for a wider business transformation.

Required Qualifications

Minimum of 8 years in digital strategy or business consulting, with a focus on cross-departmental integration
Business acumen to converse with C-suite executives about business goals, not just marketing tactics
Consultative maturity to steer C-suite conversations away from tactical "to-do lists"; toward high-level business strategy and resource allocation
Familiarity with how PR, SEO, Web Development, and AI tools integrate into a modern marketing and sales engine
Proven ability to provide high-level vision while trusting and empowering a team to handle the execution
Deep understanding of the HubSpot ecosystem and how third-party tools integrate to drive growth
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
Experience working directly in a HubSpot partner agency

The Pay Range For This Role Is

95,000 - 110,000 USD per year (Remote (United States))

new_jobs.title: Sales And Marketing Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Sales & Marketing Specialist — Role & Attribution

1. Primary Responsibility

Acquire new customers for UhYea through effective sales and marketing activities.

UhYea provides guided instructions, audience intelligence, recommended marketing channels, suggested marketing materials, and unique trackable URLs. These resources help operators identify promising opportunities and execute their work effectively without having to conduct all the underlying research themselves.

The recommendations are guidance, not restrictions. Operators may use the provided materials as-is, improve them, rewrite them, or create their own when they believe a different approach will be more effective.

2. Marketing Judgment & Performance

Marketing materials and instructions may occasionally be incomplete, inaccurate, vague, ineffective, or awkwardly worded. Operators are expected to exercise their own judgment when deciding how to use or improve them.

The objective is effective customer acquisition, not blind adherence to a script. Better messaging, stronger engagement, and more effective execution can create greater opportunities to generate traffic, conversions, and earnings.

3. Customer Attribution & Ongoing Commissions

Each operator receives a unique trackable URL to identify customers they acquire.

When a new customer signs up through an operator's assigned URL, that customer is attributed to the operator as their original acquisition. This attribution remains exclusive and is not reassigned to another operator because of subsequent visits, marketing exposure, or purchases through other channels.

For as long as the operator remains with UhYea, they are eligible to earn commissions on that customer's qualifying purchases under the program's compensation rules.

Customer retention, repeat-purchase opportunities, pricing, and continued funnel activity are managed by UhYea. The operator is rewarded for the initial acquisition that brought the customer into the business.

4. Performance Beyond Direct Acquisition

Not every marketing interaction results in a newly attributed customer. For example, an operator may generate clicks, traffic, or other valuable engagement from people who are already UhYea customers.

These activities can still contribute value to the business. Operators may therefore have opportunities to earn through qualifying performance beyond directly acquiring new customers, subject to the applicable performance and compensation rules.

5. Operating Autonomy & Tracking

Operators choose how to execute their marketing activities within applicable program rules and laws. UhYea's tracking system handles customer attribution and purchase tracking automatically, so operators do not need to submit manual reports or guess which purchases qualify.

Operators must use their assigned trackable URLs for new-customer acquisition to be credited correctly. Existing customers retain their original attribution, regardless of where they encounter subsequent marketing.

6. Compensation Principles

- Customer acquisition is rewarded because bringing a new customer into the business is a valuable contribution.
- Qualifying repeat purchases from an operator's attributed customers can continue generating commissions while the operator remains with UhYea.
- Additional qualifying performance may provide earning opportunities when an operator contributes to traffic or marketing activity without acquiring a new customer.
- Commissions are subject to qualifying-purchase requirements, the applicable refund grace period, and program rules.
- There are no guaranteed hours or earnings.

new_jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Strategist
new_jobs.description:
About the Role
We are hiring a senior, hands-on paid media strategist to independently own and improve campaign performance across Meta and Google Ads. You will build and optimize accounts, diagnose changes, develop and run tests, and make recommendations grounded in our clients' business objectives. You need to understand how the platforms actually work: what drives delivery, what limits performance, what signals they depend on, and when a proposed tactic will not work as intended. The founder will contribute business context and overall creative direction, but should not have to identify every problem, devise every test, or chase the next step.

Responsibilities
Own hands-on campaign strategy and execution across Meta and Google Ads for multiple clients, including account structure, launches, ongoing optimization, budget pacing, and performance accountability.
Monitor account health proactively. Investigate meaningful changes in spend, CPC, conversion rate, lead volume, qualified leads, cost per acquisition, revenue, and ROAS rather than waiting for problems to be flagged.
Analyze results rigorously. Choose relevant comparisons, examine change history and search terms, account for attribution delays and small samples, and distinguish plausible explanations from conclusions supported by evidence. Know when to act and when to wait.
Develop, prioritize, and execute meaningful tests across campaign types, keywords and match types, bidding, audiences, budgets, creative, and landing pages. Define hypotheses, risks, success criteria, and what to do with the findings.
Make decisions around the client's business objectives, not just the lowest CPL or highest ROAS. Recognize when growth requires more qualified leads, new demand, higher spend, or a different acquisition approach.
Use deep platform expertise to explain how auctions, automation, learning, targeting limits, placements, and conversion signals affect performance. Challenge impractical suggestions constructively and recommend workable alternatives.
Investigate gaps between platform conversions and actual outcomes, including forms, calls, booked appointments, sales, and CRM stages. Work with technical specialists on tracking, attribution, and landing-page issues and verify fixes.
Own paid-media launch and account QA: check budgets, campaign settings, targeting, exclusions, creative, destination URLs, conversion events, schedules, and Google Merchant Center or catalog feeds where relevant.
Communicate clear, decision-ready updates: what changed, what may have caused it, what you recommend, what you did, and how you will evaluate the result. Contribute confidently to internal and client performance discussions.

Requirements
6+ years of hands-on paid media experience, preferably in an agency managing multiple accounts, with demonstrated results across lead generation and ecommerce.
Expert Google Ads skills across Search, Performance Max, Shopping, and YouTube/Demand Gen as relevant. Deep command of search intent, match types, bidding, budgets, account structure, and conversion strategy.
Expert Meta Ads skills across campaign structure, audiences, placements, creative testing, automated delivery, retargeting, and conversion signals.
Proven independent ownership of account performance. You can explain decisions you made, tests you ran, trade-offs you evaluated, and what changed as a result.
Advanced analytical judgment: able to diagnose underperformance, design informative tests, spot misleading comparisons, account for attribution and sample-size limits, and avoid confusing correlation with causation.
Commercial judgment about qualified leads, bookings, sales conversion, acquisition costs, revenue, and ROAS. Able to balance efficient spending with each client's growth objectives.
Practical fluency with GA4, GTM, Google and Meta conversion tracking, enhanced conversions, Meta Pixel/CAPI, UTMs, CRM and offline conversions, and Merchant Center. Able to diagnose technical issues without necessarily coding fixes.
Sound judgment about ad messaging, creative, and landing pages. Able to identify what may be limiting response and give useful testing direction to copy, design, video, and web specialists.
Self-directed, organized, and reliable. Keeps accounts moving, follows through on investigations, and brings recommendations before being asked. Stays current with platform changes, welcomes feedback, and respectfully challenges assumptions.
Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate evidence, uncertainty, and platform limitations clearly. Full-time remote availability with substantial overlap with U.S. Central Time.

new_jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Go-to-Market (GTM) Product Marketing Manager, Portfolio and Expansion
new_jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Product Marketing and Enablement connects 1Password’s product strategy to the customer conversations that drive growth. In this Senior Staff individual contributor role, you’ll own the product-to-field motion for Unified Access, Software as a Service (SaaS) Manager, and multi-product expansion, helping Account Executives (AEs), Sales Engineers (SEs), and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) connect the needs of Information Technology (IT), security, finance, and executive buyers to the right solutions. Through clear cross-product storytelling, sales guidance, and close partnership with Product and Sales, you’ll help 1Password advance its mission to unleash employee productivity without compromising security. Reporting to the Director, Product Marketing and Enablement, this role is remote across the United States and Canada.

How We’re Using AI Today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

A track record of bringing complex technical Business-to-Business (B2B) products, new use cases, or emerging categories to market, with the ability to build product motions spanning discovery, evaluation, technical validation, purchase, adoption, and expansion.
Familiarity with sales-led enterprise organizations, including complex buying cycles, Account Executives (AEs), Sales Engineers (SEs), technical buyers, and multi-threaded customer opportunities.
Cross-functional leadership across Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and Go-to-Market (GTM) Enablement, with credibility among Information Technology (IT), security, finance, and executive audiences.
Deep fluency in multi-product enterprise software, Software as a Service (SaaS) management, or platform narratives, along with working knowledge of enterprise IT, cross-sell motions, and value-based selling.
The ability to translate technical product behavior into clear enablement content that addresses customer problems, key use cases, and business value; collaborate effectively with Product and Engineering subject-matter experts; and earn the trust of SEs and technical buyers.
Strategic leadership with limited supervision, including shaping portfolio priorities, readiness roadmaps, operating practices, and measurement approaches; influencing senior leaders without formal authority; and making thoughtful trade-offs in ambiguous environments.
Strong written and verbal communication across technical, commercial, and executive audiences, including the ability to explain complex products in plain English, develop compelling narratives, maintain a clear point of view, and update recommendations when the evidence changes. You also use artificial intelligence (AI) thoughtfully to accelerate research, analysis, and content development while retaining ownership of strategy, judgment, and quality.
Exposure to launching products, categories, or sales motions in SaaS management, enterprise platforms, cross-sell, or related markets; working with cross-functional buying groups and multi-threaded enterprise deals; using field data, call insights, win-loss feedback, or seller research to prioritize execution; or holding security certifications or equivalent technical training.

What You Can Expect

Own the product enablement plan for Unified Access, SaaS Manager, and multi-product expansion, prioritizing readiness work based on business impact, customer needs, launches, and field evidence.
Own the Unified Access field narrative, master deck, pitch decks, talk tracks, qualification questions, discovery guidance, and product training that help sellers tell one connected story.
Adapt the Unified Access and SaaS Manager stories for IT, security, finance, and executive buyers, translating product capabilities into clear customer and business value.
Define how the products fit into cross-sell, upmarket, and multi-product sales plays, including expansion from the Enterprise Password Manager base and strategies for multi-threading opportunities.
Act as an escalation point for strategic opportunities, join live customer conversations, support discovery and demos, and coach sellers through complex technical questions and objections.
Equip CSMs with the stories and guidance they need to drive cross-sell, adoption, and expansion across the portfolio.
Partner with Technical Marketing and Demo Engineering to map demos to sales plays, then use field feedback, win-loss analysis, and customer insights to improve product decisions, messaging, launches, and enablement.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $180,000 USD and $261,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $152,000 CAD and $220,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

The Role

In this high-impact role, you will be the subject matter expert and market voice for how organizations protect sensitive data wherever people work, communicate, and collaborate. You will shape the narrative for helping customers prevent data loss, reduce insider risk, support compliance, and enable secure productivity across endpoints, email, SaaS applications, and cloud environments. new_jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Product Marketing and Enablement connects 1Password’s product strategy to the customer conversations that drive growth. In this Senior Staff individual contributor role, you’ll own the product-to-field motion for Enterprise Password Manager (EPM), Agentic Access—including Developer Tools—and Privileged Access, helping Account Executives (AEs), Sales Engineers (SEs), and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) connect the needs of Information Technology (IT), security, and engineering teams to the right solutions. Through clear technical storytelling, credible sales guidance, and close partnership with Product and Sales, you’ll help 1Password advance its mission to unleash employee productivity without compromising security. Reporting to the Director, Product Marketing and Enablement, this role is remote across the United States and Canada.

How We’re Using AI Today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

Experience bringing complex technical Business-to-Business (B2B) products, new use cases, or emerging categories to market.
Experience working in a sales-led organization with enterprise sellers, Sales Engineers, technical buyers, and complex buying cycles.
Experience building a product motion across discovery, evaluation, technical validation, purchase, and expansion.
Experience partnering across Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and GTM Enablement, with the ability to build credibility with technical and executive audiences.
Deep fluency in identity security, Privileged Access Management (PAM), secrets management, or agentic access, along with working knowledge of developer tools and the ability to translate technical product behavior into clear customer-facing guidance.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, strategic judgment, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders while making thoughtful decisions in ambiguous environments.
Experience launching a new product, category, or sales motion in identity security, access management, developer tools, or a related technical market; using field insights, win-loss feedback, or seller research to prioritize work; or holding security certifications or equivalent technical training.

What You Can Expect

Own the product enablement plan for Enterprise Password Manager, Agentic Access—including Developer Tools—and Privileged Access, prioritizing readiness work based on business impact, customer needs, launches, and field evidence.
Translate Product Marketing strategy into sales motions that help IT, security, and engineering buyers secure access for developers, artificial intelligence (AI) agents, and privileged users.
Create the pitch decks, talk tracks, qualification questions, discovery guides, product training, and other field assets needed to support customer conversations from discovery through expansion.
Define how the portfolio fits into annual sales plays, including the personas to engage at each stage of the buying journey and the role of strategic technology and AI partnerships.
Act as an escalation point for strategic opportunities, join live customer conversations, support discovery and demos, and coach sellers through complex technical questions and objections.
Partner with Technical Marketing and Demo Engineering to map demos to sales plays and provide the customer, use-case, and product context needed to build credible launch and sales demonstrations.
Measure field readiness, lead win-loss analysis, identify recurring objections and adoption barriers, and bring clear recommendations to Product, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and senior leadership.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $180,000 USD and $261,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $152,000 CAD and $220,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

🌎 Remote-first work environment

You belong here.
